name: folio
description: Typography, clickable task lists and Mermaid diagrams for VS Code's built-in Markdown preview.

folio.tasks.clickable.markdownDescription: Let task-list checkboxes in the preview be clicked to check or uncheck the task in the source file.

folio.tasks.saveAfterToggle.markdownDescription: Save the file after a checkbox is toggled from the preview. A file that already had unsaved changes is never saved automatically.

folio.mermaid.theme.markdownDescription: Mermaid theme. The preview page is always white, so `default` or `neutral` read best. A `%%{init: {'theme': ...}}%%` line inside a diagram overrides this.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm test && node esbuild.mjs --production && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
